author: Linnaeus, 1758
habitat: 논, 논둑, 수로, 밭, 하천가, 초지, 목초지
summary: 전국에 찾아와 번식하는 흔한 여름철새로, 논, 논둑, 수로, 밭, 하천가, 초지, 목초지에서 산다. 다른 백로과 새들과 함께 집단번식지에서 번식한다. 다른 백로류보다 무리를 이루는 일이 잦고, 메뚜기, 개구리, 미꾸라지 따위를 주로 잡는다. 세계적으로는 모든 대륙의 열대에서 온대까지 분포한다.

points.en: rounded head, short bill and neck
orange plumes on head, neck and back (breeding)

art.subject: Eastern Cattle Egret (Bubulcus ibis coromandus, the form breeding in Korea), adult in breeding plumage, May to August: whole head, neck and upper breast washed rich golden orange-buff, the colour extending well down the neck; loose orange-buff plumes on the crown, lower foreneck and back, the back plumes lying over the folded wings; rest of the body, wings and tail pure white. Bill short and stout, yellow to orange-yellow (deep orange only briefly in early courtship), with the feathering reaching far forward under the lower mandible. Iris yellow; lores yellowish. Legs and feet dark greyish-black with a greenish tinge.
art.pose: walking through a paddy field in a loose flock, catching grasshoppers
art.scene: Korean summer farmland: green rice paddies with grassy levees and irrigation ditches; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (May–August), side view standing: golden orange-buff head, neck and breast, orange-buff back plumes, rounded head with jowl, short thick neck, deep orange-yellow bill, dark legs
adult non-breeding (from September), side view standing: all-white plumage, dull yellow short bill, rounded head and jowl, short neck, black or dark green legs and feet
art.build: Small, stocky white egret, about 50cm, clearly smaller and thicker-set than a Little Egret. Round head with a heavy 'jowl' of feathers under the bill; short, thick neck usually held in a hunched curve. Bill short and thick, about as long as the head or shorter. Legs fairly short and dark, with short bare tibia. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip; tail short and white. Walks briskly in loose flocks through grass and paddies, snapping up insects and frogs, often beside grazing cattle. In flight neck retracted, wings all white, with quicker beats than larger egrets.
avoid: Do not paint a long slender neck or a long black bill — that is Little Egret.
Do not colour the wings or tail orange; the orange-buff is limited to head, neck, breast and back plumes.
Do not paint yellow feet on black legs (Little Egret) or a bill longer than the head.
Do not restrict the orange to a small crown patch; in Korean birds it covers the whole head and neck.
